objective: Measure candidate natural behavioral defects in published COBOL-to-Java translations; no model fitting or automatic human-review claims.

split.policy: Inventory all published files; execute development only. No reserved candidate or reference compilation, execution, failure-label inspection or selection. Keep all derivatives and related task groups together. Prior retrieval exposure remains disclosed.

stages: Canonical Java controls and generated Java benchmark screening
Canonical COBOL driver execution and oracle audit
Explicit shared-input contract and same-input differential replay on eligible development cases
Count reproduced discrepancies separately from reviewed translation defects; decide model feasibility from independent family counts

admission.semanticDefect: Both exact programs execute on a shared valid input under a pinned contract and exhibit a reproducible difference; original COBOL defects/specification differences and adapter errors require adjudication. Compiler/runtime context is part of the evidence.
admission.control: Agreement on recorded tests only, never universal equivalence.
admission.review: AI analysis is not independent human review. No upstream maintainer or author votes invented; machine-reproduced discrepancies remain pending independent review.
admission.localization: Only validated/reviewed source spans constitute fault-location gold labels; attention and compiler diffs do not.

prohibitions: No replacement model training until eligible data are measured
No changes to original programs to force an expected result
No similarity or benchmark-test success relabelled as semantic proof
reporting: Shared-contract witness coverage and unresolved cases
Compiler/runtime/platform versions, exact source/tool/script hashes and collection dates
Raw logs in ignored cache with versioned metadata pointers
aiDisclosure: AI-generated audit plan and tooling; no independent human review performed by this automation.
